verdict.rationale: Digits markets Bill Pay as a single 'Drag. Drop. Approve. Pay.' flow. Its API reference documents a complete bills workflow (ingest, submit, approve, pay, reject, void) under the bills:manage scope, which covers capturing, approving and paying bills in one workflow. missing for 10: explicit evidence of payment scheduling (future-dated or scheduled payments), detail on approval routing (approver chains or rules), and in-depth bill-pay docs or independent or hands-on corroboration beyond a marketing tagline and an API index entry.
